title: Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive – Kochi
description:
About Game Wagon
 
 Game Wagon is a fast\-growing gaming and entertainment company offering console rentals, gaming experiences, tournaments, and corporate gaming events across multiple cities.
 



 We serve thousands of customers and are continuously expanding our operations, products, and customer base.
 



 We are now looking for a confident and energetic
 **Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive** 
 to join our Kochi team and help convert enquiries into bookings while building strong relationships with customers.
 


 About the Role
 
 This is a sales\-focused calling role.
 



 You will be responsible for speaking with customers who enquire about Game Wagon, understanding what they are looking for, explaining our products and packages, following up with interested leads, and converting those enquiries into confirmed bookings.
 



 You should be comfortable speaking to customers throughout the day, following up consistently, handling objections, and working towards clear sales targets.
 



 If you enjoy speaking with people and are motivated by targets and incentives, this role could be a good fit.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Call and follow up with new customer enquiries.
* Explain Game Wagon's console rental packages, pricing, offers, and available products.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend the most suitable package.
* Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Follow up with customers who have not yet completed their booking.
* Respond to leads received through WhatsApp, website enquiries, social media, and other channels.
* Maintain proper records of calls, leads, follow\-ups, and booking status in the CRM.
* Reconnect with previous customers for repeat bookings and offers.
* Upsell longer rental durations, additional controllers, games, monitors, and other relevant add\-ons.
* Coordinate with the branch team regarding availability, delivery timings, and customer requirements.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Maintain a professional and helpful customer experience at all times.


 What We Are Looking For
 * Strong communication and convincing skills.
* Comfortable making a high volume of calls and follow\-ups.
* Sales\-oriented and target\-driven attitude.
* Good spoken Malayalam and English.
* Hindi would be an added advantage.
* Basic computer and WhatsApp skills.
* Ability to understand customer needs and close sales.
* Good follow\-up discipline.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.


 Who Should Apply
 
 This role would suit candidates with experience in:
 


* Telecalling
* Telesales
* Inside Sales
* Customer Sales
* Customer Support with sales targets
* Retail Sales
* Call Centre Sales
* Lead Conversion



 Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also apply.
 


 What Success Looks Like
 
 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Does not wait for customers to call back.
* Follows up consistently until a clear answer is received.
* Understands how to convert interest into a booking.
* Is comfortable working with sales targets.
* Can build rapport quickly with customers.
* Takes ownership of their leads and conversions.


 What You’ll Get
 * Fixed monthly salary.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to grow within Game Wagon's sales team.
* Exposure to a fast\-growing gaming and entertainment business.
* Training on our products, packages, CRM, and sales process.
* Strong performers will have opportunities to move into senior sales and branch\-level roles.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Health Assist Insurance TPA Pvt Ltd, incorporated in 2005, is a leading health service facilitator and QCI\-approved, ISO\-certified Third Party Administrator licensed by the Insurance Regulatory \& Development Authority of India. The company connects insurance providers, policyholders, and a wide network of hospitals and nursing homes, delivering comprehensive health claims and assistance services. With operations in over 200 locations across India and services touching millions of lives daily, Health Assist focuses on quality customer service, robust claims management, and strong fraud and abuse control. The organization has extensive experience managing multiple state government health schemes and offers a wide range of amenities including cashless hospitalization, wellness programs, electronic identity cards, and online access to profiles and pre\-authorizations. Headquartered across 14\+ locations PAN India, Health Assist continues to expand its footprint and service offerings.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time on\-site role for a Business Development Manager / Customer Relationship Manager based in Hyderabad. The role involves identifying and developing new business opportunities with insurers, corporate clients, and healthcare providers, building long\-term relationships, and negotiating service agreements. The professional will manage key client accounts, ensure high levels of customer satisfaction, and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues related to claims, service quality, and process efficiency. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting market research, preparing proposals and presentations, tracking sales and service performance metrics, and participating in client meetings and industry events. The role also requires continuous follow\-up with stakeholders, maintaining accurate records in CRM or related systems, and contributing to strategic initiatives that enhance Health Assist’s market presence and service standards.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, and negotiation.
* Customer relationship management skills with experience in account management, stakeholder communication, and conflict resolution.
* Knowledge of health insurance, TPA operations, claims processes, and healthcare provider networks.
* Proficiency in presentation, documentation, and basic analytical skills using MS Office and relevant CRM tools.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional regional languages are an advantage.
* Ability to work independently, meet targets, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Prior experience in insurance, TPA, healthcare, or related service industries is highly beneficial.

description:
Talking to your customer and turning that conversation into a sale isn't luck it's a skill, and this internship teaches it to you from the ground up. Field Sales is an important part of this internship, and it comes with experience after preparing and then practically applying it by meeting people, pitching in person, and building the kind of confidence that doesn't come from a classroom. In three months, if you work with consistency and perseverance, you'll leave with a skill that takes most people can never buy.
   

  

**Selected Intern's Day\-to\-day Responsibilities Include**
* Learn about us: We'll teach you everything about what we do who we help, what problem we solve, and why it matters. Once you know this well, you'll be able to explain it to anyone, easily and confidently.
* Meet people in person: You'll go to events, visit relevant places, and talk to people face\-to\-face. Your job is to start simple conversations and find out who might be interested in what we offer.
* Build connections: Reach out to organizations to build relationships that can turn into future partnerships.
* Field Sales \- Pitch and explain the benefits clearly and try to convert interest into a potential customer. Even if someone doesn't sign up right away, leave them with a good impression that can turn into a future connection.
* Support our online presence: Help us run and manage ads on Facebook and Instagram to reach more people. This is optional and prior experience is a plus and will be appreciated.


 What you get in return: Freshers welcome to apply. Full training from us, real sales experience, a salary, performance\-based incentives, and a strong reference if you do well.
   

  

 Good to have: Ready to learn and perform field sales as it will help build communication sales and make you more confident in life. Stipend as per part\-time or full time commitment.

title: Sales Development Representative (US Market)
description:
**Company Description:** 




 SalesOne helps B2B companies scale revenue without the complexity of building and managing internal outbound sales teams. The company supports startups and growth\-stage businesses with end\-to\-end outbound execution, including ICP definition, lead research, list building, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, appointment setting, and sales operations. Its data\-driven approach is designed to create predictable pipeline growth by aligning strategy and execution. By consistently generating qualified meetings, SalesOne enables founders and leadership teams to focus on closing deals. SalesOne partners with B2B organizations across industries to improve outbound performance, streamline sales systems, and accelerate go\-to\-market results.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 Outbound Sales Representative(US Market) is a full\-time, onsite role based in Kochi. This role is responsible for researching and identifying target accounts, building prospect lists, and executing outbound outreach via email, phone, and LinkedIn to generate qualified meetings with US\-based decision\-makers. The individual will qualify leads through discovery conversations, understand prospect needs, and communicate the value of SalesOne’s solutions and services. Day\-to\-day tasks include maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, collaborating with sales and operations teams on campaign strategy, and following structured cadences to ensure consistent pipeline generation. The role also involves meeting and exceeding activity and performance targets, sharing market insights with leadership, and contributing to continuous improvement of outbound messaging and processes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Execute outbound sales campaigns through email, LinkedIn, cold calling, and other outreach channels.
* Represent client brands professionally during prospect interactions.
* Research target accounts and identify key decision\-makers.
* Qualify leads and schedule meetings for clients.
* Assist clients in developing outbound strategies and engagement plans.
* Manage prospect communications and follow\-up activities.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and activity tracking.
* Collaborate with Account Managers to ensure pipeline visibility and meeting success.
* Utilize AI\-powered sales tools and automation platforms to maximize outreach effectiveness.
* Support international clients across different regions and time zones.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 1\-2 years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, Inside/Outside Sales, or Outbound Prospecting.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience handling international clients or global prospects is preferred.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, or similar tools.
* Comfortable using modern sales engagement and prospecting tools.
* Strong ability to build rapport, qualify opportunities, and drive conversations forward.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and target\-driven mindset.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced SaaS and sales\-tech environment.



  





**Preferred Skills:** 



* B2B SaaS sales experience.
* Experience handling clients from the US/UK region
* Cold calling and email outreach expertise.
* Pipeline management knowledge.
* Experience with AI\-enabled sales platforms.
* Understanding of outbound sales metrics and reporting.



  





**Success Metrics:** 



* Qualified meetings booked.
* Pipeline contribution.
* Outreach performance.
* Lead qualification quality.
* Client satisfaction.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* Opportunity to work with a growing SaaS product.
* Career growth and learning opportunities.
* Exposure to B2B sales and business development.
* Collaborative and performance\-driven work environment.
* Tools: A dedicated Apple MacBook (Apple silicon\-based) will be provided during your employment.
* Work Week: A 5\-day workweek schedule.
